name: Portfolio reviews
summary: Finds the client portfolios whose review date has come, prepares a review pack from the client record, and queues the review meeting invite for an adviser to approve. Crons read and draft; a person approves every invite.

crons.name: review-due
crons.summary: Read the partner clients and flag each portfolio whose review date has come.

crons.name: prepare
crons.summary: Read each due client and write its review pack into the workflow store.

crons.name: invite
crons.summary: Queue the review meeting invite for each prepared client that has an agreed slot.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads of the partner client record. The review pack is written to the workflow store, not to a client. The invite is a live operation: it creates a calendar meeting that invites the client, so a cron only queues it.

hubspot.covers: partner client read (list and one record); review meeting invite (queued for approval)

gaps: Portfolio holdings, values, returns and fees: no mapped source. HubSpot's docs describe no portfolio data, so performance-analysis is not covered.

Midwinter AdviceOS: the kit maps 132 operations (holdings, cash flow and clients among them), but its sign-in is not wired (auth type unsupported), so no adapter is built. Confirm the sign-in scheme with Midwinter, then add an adapter.
Xplan: no operations file in the kit, so no adapter. Its public pages describe the review tools but no API.
The review date, client name and pack property names are the business's own HubSpot property names, set in settings. None is confirmed against a live account.

Recording the agreed review slot: the invite cron reads a slot from the workflow store, and nothing in core writes one yet. That needs a CRM shell action, which is a runtime change and was not made here.
Linking the invite to the client record: association type ids are not confirmed, so the invite is created with no associations.
hs_meeting_outcome SCHEDULED is an unconfirmed value. Check it on a live account before any real invite is approved.
Approving an invite makes HubSpot send the calendar invitation to the client. Confirm on a live account before the first approval.
Only the first 20 pages of partner clients are read (2,000 records). A larger book needs the cap raised after checking the run time.

Client-facing judgment steps (objectives, recommendations, compliance documentation, the statement or record of advice, the client's decision, implementing changes, follow-up) are done by the adviser. No platform step is mapped for them.
